Rule 11 of the Casa mea 3D constitution ("reguli nenegociabile") keeps these out of the early phases: PostGIS, IFC, AR, OCR and multi-country support. The rule bans complex infrastructure without a real need.

Rule 13 adds that AR, IFC and enterprise features come only after commercial validation.

ANSWER_PATH: 02_PRODUCT/projects/workspaces/casa3d/app/CONSTITUTION.md
ANSWER: Rule 11: "Fără infrastructură complexă fără nevoie reală (fără PostGIS, IFC, AR, OCR, multi-țară în fazele timpurii)." — i.e., no PostGIS, IFC, AR, OCR, or multi-country support in the early phases.
